Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Heather Modern Coffee Table, 47.2 Inch Width, Walnut
Colors: Walnut
Materials: Metal
Add a sense of modern simplicity to your home décor while improving your room’s organization with this beautiful coffee table. The walnut-hued top and base are supported by an elegant but sturdy metal frame, and the extra leather bag allows for easy storage of books and magazines. 47.2"W x 23.6"D x 15.7"H Walnut-colored MDF on a metal frame, with a leather bag Mid-century design updated to complement a modern simple style This table's 2 layers of shelves and extra leather bag offer convenient organization options. No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
